selection: Every currently public Tianjin University master/doctorate cycle in the pinned inventory. Match current program degreeLevel, university, own official guide URL, academic year, intake and existing cycle dates; source-list overlap alone is insufficient.

acquisition.method: Full web-tool reads of the two official guide HTML pages; date-only semantic assessment
acquisition.observedAtMeaning: Time returned official-page text was reviewed, not an invented origin-server raw-capture timestamp; tool crawl metadata may be cached.

groups.readScope: Full official master's guide text, including application method, scholarship exceptions, admission timing and fees sections; only dates and their scope assessed.
groups.evidenceLocator: 二、申请办法 / 申请时间
groups.quoteNormalization: Original split year-digit spacing preserved; no year inferred from URL alone.
groups.applicationScope: General master's programme-admission window, including self-funded applications. It is not a single deadline for every scholarship route.
groups.scholarshipQualification: CSC Type B applicants must wait for Tianjin University's 2027 scholarship admissions notice before applying. Type A cutoff is determined by the relevant embassy/consulate; Type B exact dates depend on the annual scholarship notice. Generic November-to-early-February text is not an exact 2027 award deadline.
groups.otherDateScope: The Tianjin municipal scholarship paragraph describes recurring May 31 subject to its annual notice; no specific scholarship record or award deadline is newly certified here.

publishRiskFlags.reason: The September 30 opening and May 31 cutoff describe the general programme application window. CSC Type B availability requires the separate 2027 scholarship notice; do not present these dates as a universal scholarship window.
Doctoral source lists also contain the master guide. This assessment binds doctoral dates solely to the doctoral guide and must not be reused to approve doctoral facts from a master source.

exclusions: The previously checked Tianjin ICLT spring route was not fetched or counted again.
No current-public undergraduate cycle belongs to the selected 244-record set; no undergraduate guide was fetched.
Programme catalogue spreadsheets were not fetched because this task rechecks shared dates, not programme identity or catalogue completeness.
Scholarship narratives were read to delimit the general application dates, but no award record was newly certified.

continuation.resumePolicy: This receipt covers date facts only for the exact pinned snapshot. Reconcile future source or catalogue changes; never renew complete-record dates from this receipt.
